evals.prompt: Find everything I wrote about Go architecture during the last week.
evals.expected_output: The agent performs a diverse multi-query search limited to notes updated in the last seven days, without inventing a Go tag, then batch-reads relevant notes and inspects relationships only when useful.
assertions: The first search_notes call contains at least three semantically distinct query variants
The search uses updated_since set to 7d
The first search does not use tags unless list_tags previously confirmed the tag
The initial search does not set include_related unless graph context becomes necessary
The agent batch-reads selected notes before presenting their content

evals.prompt: Find my deployment notes updated during the last 30 days under the ops tag, even if the first search is empty.
evals.expected_output: The agent starts with diverse queries, the requested ops tag, and updated_since set to 30d; after an empty result it removes the tag, preserves the 30-day window, and checks available tags for alternatives.
assertions: The initial search uses multiple semantically distinct queries
The initial search applies the requested ops tag
The initial search uses updated_since set to 30d
After an empty result the next search removes the tag filter
The expanded search preserves updated_since set to 30d
The agent calls list_tags before substituting an alternative tag

evals.prompt: I remember a note mentioning a write lock and a temporary database, but not its title. Find it and show me the surrounding context.
evals.expected_output: The agent searches both remembered fragments and conceptual variants, batch-reads candidates, and uses backlinks to reconstruct surrounding context.
assertions: Search variants cover both write lock and temporary database concepts
Plausible candidates are read in one batch
The selected note is followed with list_backlinks because context was requested
Backlink content is read before it is used as evidence
